items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: you could go from early guys like Omar Simeon and Leon Rappolo to the guys like Tony Scott.

ctx.x: Indeed he does. Well if you had to make a list of what you consider the top five clarinetists in jazz, could you? Would you want to?

I wouldn’t want to, and I don’t think I could. I could probably make you a list of the top two hundred, you know. I mean especially if we say living or dead. If you want to say living, I mean maybe I could pick ten guys. But if you want to say living or dead, it would be impossible. I mean you could go from early guys like Omar Simeon and Leon Rappolo to the guys like Tony Scott. I mean in my opinion everybody plays a little differently, and there’s always something that you can borrow or steal. Basically what…
